grh_065bce2ab2818aa29a71.title: Butch Minds the Baby
paragraphs: Paroled safecracker Big Butch is trying to stay straight when gangster Harry the Horse recruits him for one more job. Butch agrees only because widowed Susie O'Neill and her baby Michael desperately need money, and the robbery becomes farcical when he has to mind the baby at the same time. After the safe is blown, Butch tries to return a stolen check so its owner will avoid tax trouble and so Michael can win a promised baby-contest prize. His parole officer discovers the scheme, but recognizes that Butch's motive was to help Susie rather than enrich himself. Butch still expects to answer for the crime, yet walks away feeling that for once he has come out on top by doing something for someone else.

grh_060ae62428e4f0aac091.title: The East Wind
paragraphs: Claudette's love for Paul is repeatedly blocked by violence, pride and her unhappy marriage to Paul's brother Renee. After Renee dies as violently as he lived, Paul is far away and Claudette believes the east wind will never bring him back. He eventually returns from military service wounded and convinced that he would only burden her. grh_06fbef3220acb38da974.title: No Man Of Her Own
paragraphs: Pregnant and abandoned Helen Ferguson survives a train wreck in which newlywed Patrice Harkness and her husband are killed. Because the Harkness family had never met Patrice, Helen is mistaken for the dead woman and accepts the identity so her child can have a secure home. She falls in love with Bill Harkness, but former lover Stephen Morley discovers the fraud and blackmails her. When Morley is later found murdered, Helen and Bill each try to take responsibility, while Bill's dying mother leaves a confession meant to protect them. Police prove Morley was already dead when Helen fired at him and reveal that his actual killer has been caught, finally freeing Helen to keep the life and family she had feared losing.
